title: Fine-stage travel
requirement: The fine stage gives at least +-5 mm radial usable travel on the paper (soft limit, end stops beyond), enough that perfect knowledge of severe real tremor leaves at most 0.15 mm at the tip on the tuning split
verification: EXP-PL01; simulation rerun on the built stage's identified model

title: Fine-stage dynamics
requirement: The fine stage follows position commands with >= 25 Hz bandwidth (40 Hz proposed), <= 0.6 kg moving per axis, >= 20 N peak and >= 5 N continuous per axis, first structural mode >= 150 Hz
current_estimate: Bandwidth 15 / 25 / 80 Hz with the camera: 0.24 (0.21 to 0.27) / 0.13 (0.12 to 0.15) / 0.07 (0.06 to 0.07) mm (40 Hz: 0.09 (0.08 to 0.10)); force RMS with perfect knowledge 2.08 (1.84 to 2.36) N (SIM)

title: Coarse stage
requirement: The coarse stage moves the fine stage +-40 x +-20 mm at <= 50 mm/s and <= 2 m/s2 with feedforward of the accepted word's page motion; force capped at 20 N
current_estimate: An accepted word up to 80 mm long passes under a still pen; the references span 'se' up to 11 x 7 mm and 5.7 s; 'library' up to 35 x 8 mm and 23.2 s (SIM references)

title: Absolute tip sensing
requirement: The tip sensor reports the pen tip in the desk frame with <= 6 ms latency, <= 15 um RMS noise per axis, >= 250 samples/s, a marker <= 3 mm from the ball (tilt error <= 5 % of the hand tremor) or tilt compensation
current_estimate: Latency 10 / 15 ms leaves 0.14 (0.12 to 0.15) / 0.20 (0.18 to 0.23) mm; noise 30 um 0.13 (0.11 to 0.14) mm; tilt 10 % 0.16 (0.14 to 0.18) mm (SIM, perfect separation)

title: Hold-down and registration
requirement: The sheet is held against >= 3 N of shear (A5: about 240 Pa of vacuum, CALC) with no slip under the ball's drag, and registered to the platen frame within 0.2 mm
current_estimate: Palm rest and vacuum: the camera loop leaves 0.09 (0.08 to 0.10) mm, sheet slip 0.08 (0.07 to 0.10) mm; palm rest and a clip only: the sheet walks 1.4 (1.0 to 1.9) mm (page held) and 8.5 (7.3 to 10.1) mm (camera loop); hand on vacuum-held paper: the camera loop leaves 0.58 (0.43 to 0.72) mm at 20.0 (20.0 to 20.0) N RMS; hand on clip-held paper: the sheet travels 63 (46 to 79) mm (SIM; LuGre creep inflates slip, CON-113)

title: Palm rest
requirement: A fixed palm-rest bridge keeps the hand off the moving paper; underside 15-35 mm above the paper (25 mm nominal, the ISO 13854 finger gap), posts outside the plate's swept envelope
current_estimate: Design rule (CAD; ISO 13854 via CON-110); slip rows above

title: Pen holding in accepted mode
requirement: In accepted mode the pen is docked in a cradle, or held with the hand on the palm rest so that its tip moves <= 0.15 mm under the page's sliding drag (compliance x friction x normal force), with the normal force regulated at <= 0.5 N by the Z axis and the drag-decoupled ink-loop controller

title: Contact and lift
requirement: Load cells under the plate detect contact (>= 50 mN) within 2 ms; the Z-drop breaks contact within 40 ms and the page makes no air move until the break is confirmed
current_estimate: Air-phase ink at most 0.000 mm over all 1,735 simulated words (a 40 ms drop, 200 ms in one variant, against the plan's 200 ms lift phases) (SIM); the five-bar's lift is 200 ms

title: Safety
requirement: Force caps 20 N (fine and coarse, in hardware current limits), speed cap 50 mm/s, moving kinetic energy <= 0.05 J, no fixed gap between 4 and 25 mm at a moving edge without a skirt, SELV supply, an emergency stop that holds the stage and drops the page; the page can only drag the pen with friction (<= 0.4 N)
current_estimate: 20 N is 14 % of ISO/TS 15066's 140 N for hands (CON-111); 1.8 mJ at 50 mm/s (CALC)

title: Noise, power, size
requirement: <= 40 dB(A) at 0.5 m while writing; <= 25 W from a 24 V adapter; A5 footprint <= 380 x 300 mm, paper surface <= 70 mm above the desk
